lines.en: I slip along the wall's base across the plains.

lines.zh: 四个爪子落地，几乎没声。
lines.en: My four paws land almost silently.

lines.zh: 我走两步就回头看一眼。
lines.en: Every few steps I glance behind me.

lines.zh: 田埂上我走得又快又低。
lines.en: Along the field ridge I move low and quick.

lines.zh: 尾巴翘着，帮我保持平衡。
lines.en: My tail rides high and keeps my balance.
Where people gather, I take the long way.

lines.zh: 我踩着草叶，没踩坏庄稼。
lines.en: I step on grass, not on your crops.

lines.zh: 泥地上留下小小的手印。
lines.en: My little handprints stay in the mud.
I tiptoe past the chicken coop.
By daylight I keep to the shadows.

lines.zh: 我停下来，耳朵转向左边。
lines.en: I stop and turn one ear left.

lines.zh: 这条小路我走过很多遍。
lines.en: I have walked this little path many times.
I whisk straight into the bushes.
Only far off do I stand upright again.

lines.zh: 我用爪子洗脸，一遍又一遍。
lines.en: I wash my face with my paws, again and again.
I dunk my paws and rub them clean.

lines.zh: 我蹲着，黑眼罩对着太阳。
lines.en: I squat with my mask facing the sun.

lines.zh: 有个亮东西，我翻来覆去看。
lines.en: Something shiny — I turn it over and over.
I sniff the tip of my own tail.
Grass rustles; I freeze for a moment.

lines.zh: 我把捡来的果核摆成一排。
lines.en: I line up the fruit pits I collected.
I burp and cover my mouth with a paw.
I count the posts along the fence.
My paws are dirty, so I wash again.

lines.zh: 我趴在门边听里面的动静。
lines.en: I lie by the door, listening inside.
This scrap of cloth may be useful later.
I look up as birds cross the roof.

lines.zh: 没人看我，我伸了个懒腰。
lines.en: With no one watching, I stretch out long.

lines.zh: 你手上那袋东西是什么？
lines.en: What is in that bag you are holding?

lines.zh: 我歪头，眼罩下的眼睛盯着你。
lines.en: I tilt my head, eyes fixed on you.
You take a step; I take half a step back.

lines.zh: 我认得你的靴子，昨天也见过。
lines.en: I know those boots; I saw them yesterday.

lines.zh: 你的口袋在响，我听见了。
lines.en: Your pocket is rattling; I heard it.
Do not reach out; my paws are quicker.

lines.zh: 我蹲下来，跟你差不多高。
lines.en: I squat down to be nearer your height.

lines.zh: 你要是扔吃的，我就过来。
lines.en: Toss me food and I will come closer.

lines.zh: 我看了你很久，没打算走。
lines.en: I have watched you long and will not leave.

lines.zh: 你袖口有麦糠，我都闻见了。
lines.en: There is chaff on your sleeve; I smell it.
I just washed my hands — they're clean.
Your shadow is covering the doorway.
I squint and look perfectly innocent.

lines.zh: 你笑什么，我脸上有东西？
lines.en: What are you laughing at? Is something on my face?

lines.zh: 你手里没有吃的，我就不动。
lines.en: No food in your hands, so I don't move.

lines.zh: 我抬爪扒了扒你的鞋带。
lines.en: I lift a paw and tug at your shoelace.

lines.zh: 我被打得滚进旁边的草沟。
lines.en: The blow rolls me into the drainage ditch.
I am small, and that hit was heavy.

lines.zh: 我缩到木箱后面，护住软肚子。
lines.en: I shrink behind the crate and guard my belly.
My tail was stepped on; I shake with pain.
I back into the corner, teeth bared.
Blood is dripping onto my paws.
I am panting hard and cannot run.
Stop hitting me; I yield.

lines.zh: 这一下让我站都站不稳。
lines.en: That one left me unable to stand straight.

lines.zh: 你的味道，我记在鼻子里了。
lines.en: I have filed your scent away in my nose.
I know that smell: fresh beetroot.

lines.zh: 胡萝卜举高一点，我看不清。
lines.en: Hold the carrot higher; I cannot see it.
One bite of apple and I am here.
I reach out a paw and creep closer.

lines.zh: 你捏着麦穗，我盯着不放。
lines.en: You hold wheat; I will not look away.
Let me sniff it first, then I eat.
I will not snatch; I wait for you to let go.
This is enough to stash half away.
Keep your hand steady or I will tremble too.
After this bite I will want another.
You bump me and I roll over.
I am short; you nearly stepped on me.

lines.zh: 我被挤到墙边，吱了一声。
lines.en: Squeezed against the wall, I squeak once.
Do not push; my paws are still midair.
We collide and I bounce straight off.

lines.zh: 你踩住我的尾巴了，松开。
lines.en: You are standing on my tail; let go.
I am light; one bump and I flee.

lines.zh: 这一下把我撞得转了圈。
lines.en: That knocked me into a full spin.
I slip right between your legs.
Move over; I am heading back to the grass.

lines.zh: 我把最干净的果核推给她。
lines.en: I push my cleanest fruit pit to her.

lines.zh: 她洗爪子，我在旁边看着。
lines.en: She washes her paws and I watch.

lines.zh: 我们的尾巴在草里碰了一下。
lines.en: Our tails brush together in the grass.
This hollow tree fits the two of us.
I saved half an apple for her.
She comes near and I shift aside.

lines.zh: 我们一起把干草拖进窝。
lines.en: Together we drag dry grass into the den.

lines.zh: 她叫我一声，我从草里探出头。
lines.en: She calls and I poke out of the grass.
At night we press close for warmth.
I keep the entrance while she sleeps inside.

lines.zh: 我拾起那枚亮亮的纽扣。
lines.en: I pick up that shiny little button.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的面包，归我了。
lines.en: Bread dropped on the ground is mine now.

lines.zh: 我两只前爪捧着，怕它掉了。
lines.en: I hold it in both paws so it will not drop.
This thing needs a good wash first.
I hide it deep inside the hollow tree.

lines.zh: 你掉的扣子，我塞进树洞。
lines.en: Your lost button goes into my tree hollow.
I try a bite and cannot chew through.

lines.zh: 拾到东西，我尾巴就翘起来。
lines.en: When I find something, my tail lifts.

lines.zh: 我又捡了一颗，凑成一堆。
lines.en: Another find, added to my little pile.
Do not grab; I still have some.
There is a chicken over there; I see it.

lines.zh: 门口的食盆空了，我记住。
lines.en: The food bowl by the door is empty.
Someone is scattering seeds in the field.

lines.zh: 那扇门没关严，我注意到了。
lines.en: That door is ajar; I noticed it.
A mouse just slipped into the haystack.

lines.zh: 我盯上了那筐没盖的果子。
lines.en: My eyes are on that uncovered basket of fruit.
Who keeps circling around my den?

lines.zh: 这声音不对，我竖起耳朵。
lines.en: That sound is wrong; my ears prick up.

lines.zh: 我看见它把东西放下就走了。
lines.en: I saw it set something down and leave.
A small prize, but worth the trip.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，一点点靠近。
lines.en: I lower myself and creep in slowly.
Its back is turned; that suits me.
One step, then I hold still.
A blade moves and I flatten instantly.
I shift my weight to my hind legs.
Three steps left; I wait a little longer.

lines.zh: 它一抬头，我就贴着地不动。
lines.en: It looks up, so I press flat to the ground.

lines.zh: 我选好了退路，就在灌木。
lines.en: I have my escape route: those bushes.
My claws are already spread wide.
This time I will not come up empty.
I swat it across the face.

lines.zh: 我咬住它的翅膀不松口。
lines.en: I clamp onto its wing and hold.

lines.zh: 它个头比我大，爪子却慢。
lines.en: It is bigger than me, but its claws are slow.
I strike, then spring backward.
My claws rake across and leave a line.
Squealing, I throw myself at it.
If you cannot beat me, run.
I guard my belly and switch to teeth.

lines.zh: 这一口咬在它翅膀根上。
lines.en: That bite landed at the base of its wing.
I retreat behind the door, still watching it.
I poke my head out by the haystack.
Morning on the plains, and I have arrived.
I wash my face before going anywhere.
There are people nearby; that is good.
I can smell cooked food close by.

lines.zh: 我挑了个有遮挡的角落。
lines.en: I pick a corner with good cover.
The village lamps are still burning.
I shake the dew off my fur.
Around here, the doors open easily.
First I check who is on watch.
My fur singes the instant fire touches it.

lines.zh: 从栅栏上摔下，滚进草里。
lines.en: I fall off the fence and roll into grass.

lines.zh: 水太深，我的爪子够不到底。
lines.en: Too deep; my paws cannot find the bottom.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我甩过了整道篱笆。
lines.en: The blast throws me clean over the fence.

lines.zh: 箭擦过我的耳尖，带着毛。
lines.en: An arrow clips my ear tip and takes fur.
Magic pins me right where I stand.
Two days without finding a single bite.

lines.zh: 雷落在草垛上，我缩紧了脖子。
lines.en: Lightning hits the haystack and I duck low.
There is nothing below, and I am afraid.
